payload.set_criteria: Complete: every one of the 29 blessed steps maps to a resident requirement or is process-by-nature; every new requirement traces to a drained note or an owner ruling from this retro. Consistent: the new laws extend existing anchors (toll-grace refines toll-submit, loop-parallel-serve completes exec-parallel, shim-canary completes hot-reload) - no contradictions introduced. Affordable: 7 of 10 verify by test in the standing battery; score-absolute by demonstration with the owner's calibration round; json-tree and eta-measured by inspection at a real gate. Bounded: nothing outside the kickoff bless; worktree requirements deliberately absent - they belong to i5-worktrees and will be written at ITS M3. No TBD in any statement.
